data.name: Drive of the Dead
data.detailed_description:
DRIVE OR DIE


The dead are everywhere. Your guns fire themselves — your job is to drive. Steer, drift, and ram a weaponized car through an endless zombie horde while auto-firing weapons mow down everything in range. Runs last 5–20 minutes. You will not survive all of them.

BRING FRIENDS — ONLINE CO-OP FOR 1–4


This is why it exists: online co-op for up to 4 players (friends, no matchmaking). Run a slipstream convoy for shared damage and regen, trigger cross-car weapon combos, and revive a downed teammate before the horde finishes the job. Solo rips too — but the apocalypse is better with a convoy.

BUILD A ROLLING DEATH MACHINE


Every level, pick an upgrade card. Stack weapons — front MG, side turrets, rear shotgun, mortar, spinning sawblades, a snow plow that bowls bodies — and chain upgrades into a build that's different every run. Rescue stranded survivors for permanent boons.

THE HORDE HAS A DIRECTOR


The swarm escalates and adapts. Face special infected — acid-spitting Spitters, exploding Bombers, hulking Brutes — fight stage bosses like the Hauler, dodge the rampaging Abomination, and survive the signature Convoy Ambush. Drive the corridor toward the highway gate… if you can reach it.

ONE MORE RUN

Earn cash, unlock cars and weapons, and twist each run with modifiers (curses and blessings). Found a build you love? Share it as a Build Code — five characters your friends can paste and run.

RATED M FOR MAYHEM

A cel-shaded, schlocky B-movie apocalypse — boss title cards, deadpan radio chatter, and more exploding undead than any drive-in ever dreamed of. Crush the horde. Save the soundtrack.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op for 1–4 players (friends, no matchmaking) — slipstream convoys, weapon combos, revives
  • A roster of distinct cars and 10+ weapons to mix and match
  • 13 level-up upgrade cards plus 30+ survivor boons for run-to-run variety
  • Pick up & play — fast 5–20 minute runs
  • A procedural journey across biomes, escalating bosses, and the signature Convoy Ambush
  • Meta-progression, run modifiers, and shareable Build Codes
  • Cel-shaded B-movie visual identity

data.short_description: An online co-op auto-shooter roguelite: drive a gun-covered car through endless zombie hordes with up to 3 friends. Auto-firing weapons, run-shaping upgrade cards, and a swarm that never stops. Crush thousands. Survive the road. Save the worst B-movie ever made.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: Online co-op requires a broadband internet connection. Solo play is offline-capable.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6-core)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12 compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Horde performance scales with single-thread CPU speed.

content_descriptors.notes: Drive of the Dead is a cartoonish, cel-shaded zombie action game. Expect frequent but stylized, non-realistic violence: you crush, shoot, and explode hordes of the undead, who ragdoll and burst in over-the-top B-movie fashion. There is no realistic blood, no gore, no sexual content, and no nudity. Contains mild language and dark comedic themes.
